scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=shared -- --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev --workspace=api" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
